title: A stage run again over landed items
description: What POST /api/v1/replays and POST /api/v1/items/{key}/model-read answer. A model stage's replay answers its count and estimate first, and queues only when the request confirms it.

placed_by.description: person where the replay runs only over the labeled items, each that a person placed after the gates sent it to review, as a measurement of the stage against each placement, and null or absent where it runs over every item it selects.

model.description: The model that a quality-arm replay asks each task's run for, and null or absent for every other stage.

queued.description: False where a model stage waits for confirmation.

estimate.description: A model stage's tokens by kind over every item it covers.
